column1: Table 26.10-1 Velocity Pressure Exposure Coefficients, K_h and K_z
Height above Ground Level, z or h
column2: Height above Ground Level, z or h
Use 0.70 in Chapter 28 for Exposure B when z is less than 30 ft (9.1 m).

The velocity pressure exposure coefficient K_z may be determined from the following formula: For 15 ft (4.6 m) <= z <= z_g: K_z = 2.01 * (z / z_g)^(2 / alpha). For z < 15 ft (4.6 m): K_z = 2.01 * (15 / z_g)^(2 / alpha).
alpha and z_g are tabulated in Table 26.11-1.
Linear interpolation for intermediate values of height z is acceptable.
Exposure categories are defined in Section 26.7.
